restraints_config._comment: rgi_utils restraint-guided inference (distance + ligand conformer). RUN: export OPENFOLD_CACHE=$HOME/.openfold3; run_openfold predict --query-json restr_example.json --output-dir out --num-diffusion-samples 2 --use-msa-server false --use-templates false . gpu = torch device (true=GPU, false=CPU). start_sigma: a restraint is active only when sigma<=start_sigma; OPTIONAL per distance entry and once in conformer_restraints_config (omit -> active every step); no top-level/global start_sigma. RMSD restraint: rmsd_restraints_config below (REQUIRES a reference PDB — generate it first). '_comment' keys are ignored by the parser.

distance_restraints_config._comment: COM distance pulled to target_distance. type: harmonic{target_distance} | flat-bottomed{target_distance1,target_distance2} | flat-bottomed1 | flat-bottomed2. resid = per-chain 1-based ordinal; qualify protein groups with 'chain A and (...)' so a bare resid range does not also match the ligand (chain B). start_sigma is optional on each distance entry (omit -> every step).
distance_restraints_config.atom_selection1: chain A and ((resid 5 to 84) or (resid 186 to 224))

conformer_restraints_config._comment: Hold the ligand at its ideal RDKit geometry (bond/angle/chiral + intramolecular VdW). start_sigma here applies to ALL conformer terms (one value, all ligands); lower it to enforce ligand geometry only late in denoising.

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: RMSD restraint. Kabsch-superposed RMSD of a moving group toward target_rmsd vs a reference PDB. Generate ref_pdb first: a vanilla prediction of this sequence converted to PDB (gemmi make_pdb_string). Atoms pair by IDENTITY (chain, resid, atom-name), so the ref atom order need not match. atom_selection is OPTIONAL: omit it (as below) to fit + measure RMSD over the WHOLE structure best-effort (atoms missing from the ref are skipped); add atom_selection_ref/target (or _fit/_calc) e.g. 'chain A and (resid 90 to 180)' for a region. start_sigma/weight optional.
